**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Skip durable fallback writes for detached runs**

When `sessionPersistence` is `"detached"` and a third-party harness omits the optional finalizer, this newly enters the fallback path. The orchestrator still supplies the resolved durable session identity, and `persistSettledToolFallbackTranscript()` writes through it without checking `sessionPersistence`, violating the contract in `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/params.ts:98-99` that detached runs never write durable transcript state. If the borrowed session row exists, an ephemeral/helper run can therefore leak this fallback into the durable conversation; skip mirror persistence for detached runs and cover the absent-callback case.

+attempt and retry loop. An empty result gets one more tool-free finalization
+attempt. If the callback is missing, throws, or exhausts both attempts without
+visible text, an otherwise eligible required visible turn receives one
+deterministic host fallback. OpenClaw persists that fallback as one idempotent
+assistant mirror and marks it for delivery through source-reply suppression. It
+does not call `runAttempt`, repeat the original model turn, or replay completed
+tools. Canonical failed-tool metadata remains attached to the terminal result.
+Runs with `silentExpected` never synthesize or persist this fallback.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Make fallback persistence cancellation-atomic**

When the callback is absent and cancellation arrives after `appendAssistantMirrorMessageByIdentity()` commits its append but before its post-append abort check, the resulting abort is swallowed by `persistSettledToolFallbackTranscript()` and the outer function returns the original cancelled attempt, while the fallback remains durably visible in the transcript. This contradicts the new cancellation guarantee; make persistence/building cancellation-atomic or retain the committed outcome, and test a committed append followed by cancellation rather than only an `ok: false` mock.
